PFT.nameLong: Most frequent WorldCover class within 1 km of the site in 2020 and 2021, with the nearest year outside that range

PFT_grid.nameLong: WorldCover class of the 10 m grid cell holding the site in 2020 and 2021, with the nearest year outside that range

PFT_merged.nameLong: BADM PFT of the site from pft_path, filled with the most frequent WorldCover class within 1 km where the csv has none
PFT_merged.description: IGBP number, 1 ENF, 2 EBF, 3 DNF, 4 DBF, 5 MF, 6 CSH, 7 OSH, 8 WSA, 9 SAV, 10 GRA, 11 WET, 12 CRO, 13 URB, 14 CVM, 15 SNO, 16 BSV, 17 WAT. The PFT of the site in pft_path on every time step. Sites missing from the csv or with a PFT that is not an IGBP class, such as TBD, take the most frequent WorldCover class within 1 km of each year as its BADM PFT, When that class has no BADM PFT, the class of the grid cell holding the site is used, and years with neither take the nearest year that has one.
